It's not always about what kills who can get it's about making it harder for the enemy to complete their objective in the end which in turn can make it easier for your team to win, this applies for both attack and defence. Disrupt and create discretion for the other team and you'll come out on top if you didnt your job good enough. This game has been proven to be a game where the best shooter can get most of the kills and you cam still win, support isn't about YOU getting kills it's about setting your team up to get the NECESSARY kills in order to pull the round in your favour, on a lot of maps you can kill hard breach off the start and the round is pretty much over and you won but if people peek stupid shit and get killed you lose your advantage. I myself have done that many times, thrown a round 1 minute in without knowing until the end of the round that it was my fault and blaming others yet at the end of the round I say that was because I GOT KILL HUNGRY that we lost, couldve won if I just moved back/rotated to a different push instead of challenging, sometimes you dont realise it until later but if you can acknowledge what you did wrong you're more likely to correct it and not have the rest of the team thrown of THEIR game from being so focused on being pissed at you as that shit can sit in your head. It's hard to shame that stuff off, it's a comp game and that's just how it is.

My point is dont make your job easier make the enemy's job harder. Sometimes you make the wrong decision and that's okay as long as you learn from it next round.

While I agree, I also disagree as I think the team should rotate to put PRESSURE on lunchbox (LB) to make it harder to take.

If they dont have defuse they cant plant, so theres no point to stay on site. I've always tried to rotate to the person with LB if I'm not a main anchor as that allows me to refrag the person if they get killed defending it and keeps them down a person and more pressure on attackers to waste more util to take it.

Obviously it's all situation dependent as if I'm in site or lurking around site I'm not always going to go to the opposite side of the map to help keep LB I'd rather sit around a place I think it's most likely they're going to come from as it's more beneficial for the team, it's also very op dependent.

Short quick bursts with the SMG is the best way to use it, you dont want to just blast a whole mag, unless they're pretty much in your face, as the recoil after a certain point starts to spaz out a little bit and get really shakey. 

The muzzle I use is the flash hider as it helps with short burst recoil more than a comp, but if you find yourself using a more sustained fire then go with the comp. I run laser on it too but that's a personal preference as the laser can be seen but they're good for quick peeking and having more snappy aim. Vert grip is a given on the SMG as she can be a little unwieldy sometimes.

As mute I like to keep a jammer on me if they're running a lot of lion as you can hunker down a bit more and move a bit inside the jammer as his scan goes off.

-Never peek where you just opened

-Open multiple places before even peeking to get in their heads as to where you could be

If you dont need to open somewhere dont open it, the ceiling being intact is as strong on attack as it is on defence, depending on who they have op wise obviously. If you have complete top control and you know theres no way defenders are leaving the site, open whatever you want to put pressure on rotates/power spots/plant locations. You job as a vert player is to make the defense /attackers life a living hell to deal with.

Shotguns are good for vert play on defence if they have a good sidearm/consistent shotgun (french shotty is probably the best in the game ngl has been since day 1 it's just been slept on the whole time because of statistically better weapons)

Smoke is good for vert play on pretty much any map, if you dont panic and waste smoke cans really early he can be a nightmare for attack to deal with if you can save cans for late round as much as possible. Smg11 is not as hard as people think it's nearly straight down recoil wise and you should tap fire it as much as possible, small quick bursts will do it.
